日本外务省（MOFA）主源未列学历层级门槛（官方页 educat / high: MOFA's main page sets no academic-level threshold (zero hits for educat / high school), so no minimum qualification applies. The receiving office does ask for proof of highest education — a copy of the graduation certificate, an original enrolment (or leave-of-absence) certificate — but only to verify identity and background, not as a level requirement. The Taipei office wording: proof of highest education, such as an original enrolment (or leave-of-absence) certificate or a copy of the graduation certificate.
无强制语言考试门槛。台湾窗口 FAQ 原文：「打工度假簽證的申請，並不會因為申請: No compulsory language test. The Taipei office Q&A states: an application for a working holiday visa will not be refused just because the applicant's Japanese is weak, but when applications are numerous a Japanese-language qualification may count as one relative criterion — weak Japanese is not a ground for refusal, but when applications outnumber visas a JLPT pass can count as a relative advantage. Japanese proof (JLPT, BJT) is optional supporting material.
资格条件只要求「足以维持初期停留的合理资金」（官方原文 Possessing r: The eligibility condition only asks for reasonable funds to cover the initial stay (official wording: Possessing reasonable funds for the maintenance of his/her stay during the initial period of stay in Japan) plus a return ticket or the means to buy one; MOFA gives no figure. The receiving office does publish one: the Taipei office requires an original bank deposit certificate of at least TWD 80,000 issued within the past month. Bankbook copies are not accepted, and if the funds belong to a relative you must add a household registration transcript issued within three months proving the relationship.
须已投保覆盖在日停留期间生病、受伤、死亡的保险，领证时提交正式证明。台湾窗口原文: You must already hold insurance covering illness, injury and death during the stay in Japan, and present the formal certificate when collecting the visa. Taipei office wording: insurance covering illness, injury and death during the stay in Japan; the Q&A adds any insurance that covers illness, injury and death in all circumstances during your stay in Japan is acceptable (National Health Insurance excepted) — any policy that pays out counts, with no restriction on type or sum insured, National Health Insurance excepted.
参加次数有上限。自 2026 年 2 月起，日本打工度假制度的参加次数由原本一生: The number of participations is capped. From February 2026 Japan raised the lifetime limit from one participation to two, and the visa-issuance cap rose to two accordingly — official wording: from February 2026 the number of participations in Japan's working holiday scheme changed from one in a lifetime to a maximum of two. A visa that was approved but never collected, or collected and then allowed to lapse unused, still counts as one of the two.
日台之间 2026 年度分两期受理，均由日本台湾交流协会台北/高雄事务所承办：前: The Japan–Taiwan arrangement runs two intake rounds per year, both handled by the Japan–Taiwan Exchange Association's Taipei and Kaohsiung offices: round one 2026-04-20 (Mon) to 04-30 (Thu), round two 2026-10-19 (Mon) to 10-30 (Fri), with 10-26 closed for the Retrocession Day make-up holiday. Results published 2026-06-18 and 2026-12-11. Visa collection runs about six months: 2026-06-22 to 12-18 for round one, 2026-12-14 to 2027-06-11 for round two. Other partner countries and regions set their own windows through the local Japanese mission.
日台 2027 年度受理日程尚未公告。往年规律为每年两期（约 4 月下旬、10: The 2027 Japan–Taiwan schedule has not been announced. The recent pattern is two rounds a year, in late April and mid-to-late October; re-check the window before applying.
日台之间按互惠免收签证手续费（台湾窗口 FAQ 原文：「申請的手續費用是多少？免: Japan and Taiwan waive the visa fee on a reciprocal basis — the Taipei office Q&A states the application fee is free and the association keeps a separate page titled implementation of the visa fee waiver for the working holiday scheme. MOFA's general schedule is about JPY 15,000 for a single-entry visa and JPY 30,000 for a multiple-entry one (announced 24 June 2026, in force from 1 July 2026), which applies at windows without a waiver arrangement, such as the Consulate-General in Hong Kong.
分两段：受理期结束后统一审查，从申请截止到合格者发表约 6-7 周（2026 前: Two separate stages. All applications received in a round are reviewed together after the intake closes, and results come out about 6-7 weeks after the deadline (2026 round one closed 04-30, results 06-18; round two closes 10-30, results 12-11). The association states a working holiday visa is not reviewed on a first-come, first-served basis — first come is not first served; when applications exceed places, selection favours those who best match the scheme's purpose, and an interview may be required.
白底彩色证件照 1 张，直 4.5cm × 横 3.5cm，6 个月内拍摄，正面: One colour photo on a white background, 4.5 cm high by 3.5 cm wide, taken within six months, front-facing, hatless, plain background, affixed to the application form (Taipei office rule; other offices may specify different dimensions).
8 万新台币以上的银行存款证明正本，须为 1 个月内申请开具；存折影本不予认可；: Original bank deposit certificate showing at least TWD 80,000, issued within the past month. Bankbook copies are not accepted. If the funds belong to a relative, attach a household registration transcript issued within three months proving the relationship (Taipei office rule).
领证时提交已投保的正式证明文件；险种与保额不限，只要覆盖在日期间的生病、受伤、死: Present the formal certificate of insurance when collecting the visa. Any policy counts as long as it covers illness, injury and death during the stay in Japan; no restriction on type or sum insured (National Health Insurance excepted).
须用协会最新格式（2026 年 9 月更新版），由本人以中文或日文书写；签名栏必: Must use the association's current form (updated September 2026) and be written by the applicant in Chinese or Japanese; the signature line must be hand-signed.
说明希望利用打工度假制度的理由，由本人以中文或日文书写；第二次申请者须写明为何希: Explain why you want to use the working holiday scheme, written by the applicant in Chinese or Japanese. Repeat participants must state why they want a second round.
说明赴日后想从事的活动内容，由本人以中文或日文书写。申请表、履历书、理由书、计划: Describe what you intend to do after arriving in Japan, written by the applicant in Chinese or Japanese. The application form, CV, reason letter and plan must be on the association's designated paper.
毕业证书影本、在学（休学）证明正本等；未注明「依教育部规定本证可替代在学证明」的: Copy of graduation certificate, original enrolment (or leave-of-absence) certificate, and the like. A student card that does not carry the note this certificate may replace proof of enrolment under Ministry of Education rules is not accepted.
台湾地区移民署 10 日内核发，须载明最近三年入出境纪录与地点。: Issued by Taiwan's National Immigration Agency within the past 10 days; must record entries and exits for the last three years, including the ports used.
由本人亲自到窗口递交，不接受代理申请与邮寄申请（台湾窗口 FAQ：「必須由本人親: Apply in person at the counter — neither agents nor post are accepted (Taipei office Q&A: the applicant must come to the counter in person). Hong Kong SAR passport holders apply at the Consulate-General of Japan in Hong Kong; Taiwan passport holders apply at the Japan–Taiwan Exchange Association's Taipei or Kaohsiung office. Applications cannot be lodged inside Japan, and submitting to both Taipei and Kaohsiung in the same round voids both. An interview may be scheduled if the examiner considers it necessary.
受理期结束后统一审查，合格者以「受理号码」形式公告在协会网站、Facebook: All applications in a round are reviewed together after the intake closes. Successful applicants are announced by acceptance number on the association's website, on Facebook and on the notice boards at both offices; results are not given by phone or at the counter. 2026 announcements fall on 06-18 and 12-11. The collection period starts the next day and runs about six months — miss it and the approval lapses. The visa is valid for one year from the first day of the collection period, you must enter Japan within that year, and the immigration officer then grants a full year of stay from the date of entry.
申请截止到合格发表约 6-7 周；领证期间约 6 个月: About 6-7 weeks from the application deadline to the results; the visa collection window runs about six months
不可续签、不可延期，也不可在日本境内变更为其他在留资格（台湾窗口 FAQ：「一年: Cannot be renewed, cannot be extended, and cannot be switched to another status of residence inside Japan (Taipei office Q&A: after the one-year period it can be neither extended nor converted to another status of residence). Some partner countries allow a second participation — Japan and Taiwan moved to a maximum of two from February 2026 — but each round is a fresh visa application, not an extension of the current stay.
打工是度假的附带活动，用于补充旅费（官方原文 engage in employm: Work is an incidental activity of the holiday, meant to top up travel funds (official wording: engage in employment as an incidental activity of their holidays for the purpose of supplementing their travel funds); this is not a work visa. The Taipei office Q&A states plainly that there is no specific restriction on working hours — no cap on hours — while the content is restricted: no work in bars, adult entertainment or other specially licensed premises, and breaches can lead to arrest, deportation and future entry bans. Students going to Japan for an internship that forms part of their curriculum need a different visa and cannot use the working holiday scheme.
本记录多个字段原无官方来源，已于 2026-10-29 复核后删除或改写：资金数: Several fields in this record had no official basis and were removed or rewritten in the 2026-10-29 review: the fund amount (originally JPY 250,000, now the receiving office's TWD 80,000), the processing time (originally 5-15 working days, now the actual two-stage schedule), the study-duration cap (originally six months), the 88-day farm-work extension (originally in renewal_condition), the claim that weekly hours are uncapped, and the age relaxation to 35 (originally in age.note). Find official support before relying on any of those figures.

问答原文：签证有效期自领证期间第一日起算，停留期自入境日起算；一年期满不得延长或: Q&A as published: the visa is valid one year from the first day of the collection period and the stay counts from the date of entry; after one year it can be neither extended nor converted to another status; there is no specific restriction on working hours; insurance need only cover illness, injury and death (National Health Insurance excepted); the application fee is free; weak Japanese is not a ground for refusal but may weigh relatively when applications are numerous; applications must be lodged in person.
